title: 长羽毛的恐龙
subtitle: 先是绒毛，后来才会飞
character: wearing a rust red t-shirt, forest green shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, oil pastel drawing with thick waxy strokes and grainy overlaps, rust red, warm cream and deep forest green

pages.zh:
石头上有一只恐龙，
骨头旁边
还留着一圈毛。
爸爸说，
那是羽毛的印子。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up leaning close to a stone slab with a small dinosaur skeleton and faint feather marks pressed into it, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, curious.

pages.zh:
最早的羽毛
不是一片，
是一根。
细细的一根丝，
像小狗身上的绒毛。

它满身都是这种丝。
一根一根立着，
把身子裹起来。
风吹不透，
身上就一直是暖的。
pages.scene: One small dinosaur standing on two legs covered all over in short fine fuzz, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
后来这根丝
从根上分了叉。
一根变成好几根，
聚成一小簇，
蓬蓬的更暖和。

再后来，
中间长出一根梗，
两边排开细丝，
合成平平的一片。
这才叫一根羽毛。

羽毛还有颜色。
有的漆黑，
有的会发亮。
它把脖子一伸，
远远的就看得见。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur standing tall with its neck stretched up and its dark glossy neck feathers raised, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它胳膊上的羽毛
长得最长。
越靠外越长，
一排排开，
合起来像一把扇子。

有一天它跳了下来。
胳膊往两边一张，
羽毛兜住风，
身子慢慢往下飘，
一点也没摔疼。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur leaping off a tree branch with both feathered arms spread wide and gliding down through the air, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
羽毛还有一个用处。
它蹲在窝上，
把翅膀盖下去，
底下的那些蛋
就一直是暖的。
pages.scene: One feathered dinosaur crouching on a nest of eggs with its feathered arms spread over them, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
今天的鸟
身上也是这个。
把两根羽毛
并在一起比一比，
几乎分不出来。

羽毛那么软，
本来留不下来。
可它落进细泥里，
泥慢慢变成石头，
印子就留住了。
pages.scene: One flat stone with the clear mark of a single feather pressed into it, seen from directly above on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
楼下捡到一根羽毛。
羽毛不是为了飞
才长出来的，
是先长出来，
后来才用来飞。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up holding up one small feather between two fingers, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, smiling.
